blockers.title: Declared paired absolute_clean_harm metric is not emitted
blockers.evidence: The frozen config and packet declare absolute_clean_harm in the paired summary. evaluation.paired_metrics returns P/U/S/WCD/TCD3 and metadata but no absolute_clean_harm. phase_official_eval stores that return value without checking keys against the config, so a full run can be accepted with a predeclared output missing. The later report's per-class clean-minus-S4 AP50 does not satisfy this official paired sink.
blockers.required_closure: Compute the approved absolute_clean_harm paired output, or revise the approved config/packet before the run; enforce emitted metric keys against the frozen declaration.

blockers.title: Actual clean val2017 image bytes are not bound to the pinned per-image manifest
blockers.evidence: The release pins and hashes the manifest file, but evaluation never reads its per-image image_sha256/image_bytes entries. It derives paths from annotation names, checks existence and dimensions, then evaluates current bytes. A same-name, same-dimension substituted JPEG can reach COCOeval undetected. The bounded smoke/reference comparison uses the same current bytes and cannot detect substitution.
blockers.required_closure: Verify the 5,000 annotation IDs/names/dimensions against the pinned manifest, verify every input image's byte count and SHA256, and retain a verification receipt in official output.

evidence_gaps.title: Protocol identity is linked but not explicit in official result fields
evidence_gaps.evidence: The immutable source release carries risk_estimator_policy and strict_Original_S4_equivalence_claim=false, and the result records its release SHA256. phase_spec/status/accepted do not copy those fields directly. Values are recoverable by the bound hash, so this is an attribution gap, not a primary blocker.
evidence_gaps.recommended_closure: Copy the exact verified protocol fields into phase_spec and accepted/status metadata and validate them at acceptance.
